KeysToEntries.ui.mainmenu.tooltip.steam: Visit our Dedicated Server's Steam page. From there, you can freely download the dedicated server binaries to host those yourself, at home or in the cloud. For the more technically minded players.
KeysToEntries.ui.mainmenu.tooltip.rental: Host your game with Shockbyte, our preferred hosting partner. In just a few click, you can easily and securely rent a server to play with your fellow adventurers.
KeysToEntries.ui.mainmenu.tooltip.host_dedicated_serve: You can host a dedicated server at home or in the cloud. Please visit Jagex' website for more information.
KeysToEntries.ui.mainmenu.tooltip.rental_consoleVersio: You can easily and securely rent a server from a third-party to play with all your fellow adventurers.
KeysToEntries.ui.mainmenu.selectdedicatedserverhosting: Learn more about dedicated server hosting by hovering on the following options.
